LanguageData.SSC_Identity_BoundTip: An existing master-slave bond prevents role changes. Bound sex slaves and masters with bound sex slaves must keep their current role.
LanguageData.SSC_Identity_SelectionUnavailable: Cannot switch to Master now. Check Master qualification and existing bonds.
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_AllowDirectMasterSelection: Allow direct manual selection of Master identity
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_AllowDirectMasterSelection_D: Enabled by default. Allows choosing Master from the identity menu without granting permanent Master qualification. When disabled, qualification is required. Existing identities are retained, and bonds still prevent identity changes.
